data.turoyo: <...> heš kəle i nuro b gawe, heš lə bayiro. <...>
data.translation: <...> Es ist noch Feuer darin, es ist noch nicht abgekühlt. <...>

rationale: Thin Preterit Intransitive cell; negated thermal change with a feminine subject, contrasting with faded colour.

summary: heš lə bayiro is read as feminine Preterit Intransitive in the fire/heat discourse. Identical written bayiro in muklo bayiro is Part act.; spelling alone does not select the box.
The negated predicate asserts that cooling has not occurred, not that the heat has already been lost.
Confirm whether bayiro refers to i nuro, to heat or to an unexpressed bath subject. The preceding feminine fire NP favors the first, but the exact referent remains contextual.
Loss of a property includes heat in a still-heated bath/furnace context, alongside existing colour and taste examples.
